views.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet the greatest opportunity; proven better new framework reduces risk.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月：消费级 AI 虽不可投资，却是最大机遇；采用“已验证、更优、新颖”框架降低风险。

views.en: Copying proven products is moral arbitrage; start small and humble, not grand.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月至 7 月：复制已验证产品是道德套利；从小处着手，而非宏大愿景。

views.en: Consumer apps face distribution challenges; enterprise and prosumer markets offer better opportunities.
views.zh: 2026 年 7 月：消费级应用面临分发难题；企业级和专业人士市场机会更佳。

views.en: Distribution is fundamental; pick the right body of water over the right boat.
views.zh: 2026 年 8 月：分发至关重要；选择正确的“水域”比“船”更重要。

views.en: Retention, especially day-365, is core; free unlimited compute will reshape consumer services.
views.zh: 始终：留存（尤其第 365 天留存）是核心；免费无限算力将重塑消费服务。

views.en: Scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training; continual learning is missing for AGI.
views.zh: 2026 年：扩展强化学习比扩展预训练更难；持续学习是 AGI 缺失的一环。

views.en: Transformers are a bottleneck; new architectures needed for continual learning and test-time adaptation.
views.zh: 2026 年：Transformer 成为瓶颈；需要新架构以实现持续学习和测试时适应。

views.en: Pre-training plus RL is the core formula; alignment is an ever-evolving pursuit.
views.zh: 始终：预训练加强化学习是核心公式；对齐是不断演进的追求。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员
people.bioEn: Mechanistic interpretability researcher at Anthropic, working on superposition, dictionary learning and circuit tracing to understand what actually happens inside large models.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 机制可解释性研究员，研究叠加、字典学习与电路追踪，试图搞清大模型内部到底发生了什么。

episodes.tEn: RL for Language Models Finally Works: Expert Performance in Math and Code

people.tiEn: VP of Research (AI for Science), Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁（AI 科学）
people.bioEn: VP of Research at Google DeepMind, where he leads AI for Science. His teams apply AI to protein folding, mathematics, materials and other scientific frontiers.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁，主管 AI for Science。其团队把 AI 用于蛋白质折叠、数学、材料等科学前沿。

episodes.tEn: AlphaGo: The Match That Changed AI Forever
AlphaFold 3: Unlocking the Structures of Life's Molecules

views.en: AI in science should tackle root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
views.zh: 2024 年，我认为 AI 在科学中应解决根本性问题而非狭窄应用，以产生广泛影响。

views.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
views.zh: 2024 年，我提出将大模型的幻觉与真值检测器结合，可激发创造性发现。

views.en: AI systems must be forced to generalize, not memorize, by using hard evaluation metrics.
views.zh: 2024 年，我强调通过严格评估指标迫使 AI 泛化而非记忆。

views.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence, but struggle to go beyond human data.
views.zh: 2026 年，我认为大语言模型是智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据。

views.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
views.zh: 2026 年，我指出基于强化学习的后训练是超越人类知识的关键。

people.tiZh: AI 研究员（前 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: AI researcher known as a co-creator of chain-of-thought prompting, and for work on o1 and Deep Research. A prominent voice on reasoning and emergent abilities in large models.
people.bioZh: AI 研究员，思维链提示的共同提出者之一，参与 o1 与 Deep Research。是大模型推理与涌现能力方面的重要声音。

episodes.tEn: Intelligence as a Commodity: Three Key Trends for AI in 2025

people.tiZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CTO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CTO of Reflection AI and a co-creator of AlphaGo and AlphaZero at DeepMind. A reinforcement-learning researcher turned frontier-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CTO，DeepMind 时期是 AlphaGo 与 AlphaZero 的共同创造者。从强化学习研究者转向前沿智能体的构建者。

episodes.tEn: From AlphaGo to AI Agents: Giannis on Breakthroughs in Reinforcement Learning

people.tiEn: Head of AGI Safety & Alignment, Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind AGI 安全与对齐负责人
people.bioEn: Head of AGI Safety and Alignment at Google DeepMind. A leading voice on interpretability, oversight and how to make advanced AI systems safe from the inside.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind AGI 安全与对齐负责人。在可解释性、监督以及如何从内部让先进 AI 系统更安全方面是重要声音。

episodes.tEn: Why AI Alignment Might Not Be Catastrophic: Rohan Sha's Optimistic Take

people.tiZh: Wayve 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Wayve and a PhD roboticist who pioneered end-to-end learned autonomous driving and generative driving world models. A champion of embodied AI.
people.bioZh: Wayve 联合创始人兼 CEO，机器人学博士，开创了端到端学习的自动驾驶与生成式驾驶世界模型。倡导具身智能。

episodes.tEn: From Farm to Frontier: Alex Kendall on Wayve's End-to-End AI for Autonomous Driving
From AV 1.0 to 2.0: The Rise of End-to-End Neural Networks in Autonomous Driving

views.en: End-to-end deep learning outperforms hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors.
views.zh: 端到端深度学习优于手工编码栈；世界模型支持推理和涌现的安全行为。

views.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar; AV 3.0 may move intelligence outside the car.
views.zh: 纯视觉可达到人类水平，但超越人类安全需要雷达和激光雷达；AV 3.0 可能将智能移至车外。

views.en: Autonomous driving is fundamentally an AI problem solved with end-to-end learning; scaling requires massive data, compute, and world models.
views.zh: 自动驾驶本质上是 AI 问题，端到端学习解决；规模化需要海量数据、算力和世界模型。

views.en: Zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible; consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis in the short and medium term.
views.zh: 零样本泛化可覆盖 500+ 城市；消费级车辆将在中短期超越 Robotaxi 规模。

views.en: Infrastructure and data quality are more critical than algorithmic innovation; safety is paramount with minimal risk maneuvers.
views.zh: 基础设施和数据质量比算法创新更关键；安全至上，最小风险操作提供第三选项。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at Google DeepMind and lead author of the Dreamer series of world models, which learn to imagine and plan. A central figure in world-model research.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家，Dreamer 系列世界模型的主要作者——让智能体学会想象与规划。是世界模型研究的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Pathways to AGI: Architecture, Compute, and Beyond LLMs

people.tiZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Lindy, building AI employees that live in Slack, connect to company tools and accumulate a team's shared context. Previously founded Teamflow and spent years at Uber; a frequent, opinionated voice on agents, memory and AI policy.
people.bioZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO，做「住在 Slack 里」的 AI 员工——接上公司工具、积累团队共享上下文。此前创办 Teamflow、在 Uber 多年；在智能体、记忆与 AI 政策话题上是高频且观点鲜明的声音。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at OpenAI who built Deep Research and helped build ChatGPT Agent, training agents end-to-end with reinforcement learning. A leading agents researcher.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究科学家，打造了 Deep Research 并参与 ChatGPT Agent，用强化学习端到端训练智能体。是智能体研究的一线人物。

episodes.tEn: The Origin Story of OpenAI's Deep Research

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and lead author of the GPT-3 paper. He leads the compute and scaling effort that trains frontier models like Claude.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，GPT-3 论文的主要作者。主导训练 Claude 等前沿模型的算力与扩展工作。

episodes.tEn: From Awkward Kid to AI Co-Founder: Tom Brown's Journey

people.tiZh: Anthropic 哲学家
people.bioEn: Philosopher at Anthropic who shapes the character and values of Claude. She works at the intersection of philosophy and AI alignment, thinking about how models should behave, hold values, and treat the people they talk to.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 哲学家，负责塑造 Claude 的性格与价值观。工作处在哲学与 AI 对齐的交叉点，思考模型应如何行事、秉持价值观、以及如何对待与之交流的人。

episodes.tEn: A Philosopher at Anthropic: Shaping AI Character and Ethics

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher on the OpenAI reasoning team. Known for leading work behind the model that reached IMO gold-medal level, and for using a general-purpose model to help disprove a decades-old mathematical conjecture. Focuses on advanced reasoning and math.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 推理团队研究员。以主导达到 IMO 金牌水平的模型工作、以及用通用模型协助推翻一个存在数十年的数学猜想而知名。专注高级推理与数学。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Math Breakthrough: The Story Behind the Discovery

people.tiZh: MCP 联合创造者 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Co-creator of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) at Anthropic, the open standard that connects AI models to external tools and data. An engineer focused on the plumbing that lets agents act reliably in the real world.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 的 Model Context Protocol（MCP）联合创造者——连接 AI 模型与外部工具、数据的开放标准。专注让智能体在现实世界中可靠行动的底层工程。

episodes.tEn: Anthropic Donates MCP to Linux Foundation: Standardizing AI-Application Connections

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a lead architect of GPT-3 during his time at OpenAI. He focuses on AI safety, alignment and responsible scaling, and speaks candidly about AGI timelines and the risks that keep him up at night.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，在 OpenAI 期间是 GPT-3 的主要架构者之一。他专注于 AI 安全、对齐与负责任扩展，常坦率谈论 AGI 时间表与令他担忧的风险。

episodes.tEn: The Last Invention: Ben Mann on AGI by 2028, AI Safety, and the Future of Humanity

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher at OpenAI who helped build Canvas, Tasks and the o1 chain-of-thought models. Previously at Anthropic, where she led post-training and evaluation for the Claude 3 family. Writes on model behavior and why soft skills matter in an AI world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究员，参与打造 Canvas、Tasks 与 o1 思维链模型。此前在 Anthropic 主导 Claude 3 系列的后训练与评测。关注模型行为，以及 AI 时代为何软技能愈发重要。

episodes.tEn: The Art of Model Crafting: Why Post-Training Is Subjective
Building the Cutting Edge: Inside OpenAI with Karina Nguyen

views.en: Post-training is an art, not science; synthetic data overcomes pre-training data wall.
views.zh: 2025 年：后训练更像艺术而非科学；合成数据可突破预训练的数据瓶颈。

views.en: Evals are bottleneck; need continuous benchmarks as models saturate quickly.
views.zh: 2025 年：评估是瓶颈；模型快速饱和，需要持续更新的基准。

views.en: Shift from hard skills to soft skills; AI automates technical tasks.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：从硬技能转向软技能；AI 自动化技术性任务。

views.en: Benchmarks must be continuous, not fixed, to counter reward hacking.
views.zh: 2026 年：基准必须持续更新而非固定，以应对奖励黑客。

views.en: Models should have diverse personalities; more companies should train own models.
views.zh: 2026 年：模型应有多样化个性；更多公司应训练自己的模型。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人
people.bioEn: Leads robotics and hardware at OpenAI. Previously led hardware for the Meta AR glasses and Oculus VR, and engineered products at Apple. A champion of physical AI, bringing intelligence into the physical world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人。此前领导 Meta AR 眼镜与 Oculus VR 硬件，并曾在苹果做产品工程。她倡导物理 AI——让智能进入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: From VR to Robotics: The Next Frontier in Physical AI

people.tiZh: AngelList 联合创始人；天使投资人与思想者
people.bioEn: Co-founder of AngelList and one of tech's most-quoted thinkers on wealth, leverage and happiness. An early investor in Uber and Twitter, he now hosts the Naval podcast and writes on how AI reshapes work and startups.
people.bioZh: AngelList 联合创始人，科技圈被引用最多的思想者之一，谈财富、杠杆与幸福。Uber、Twitter 早期投资人，现主持 Naval 播客，探讨 AI 如何重塑工作与创业。

views.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
views.zh: 2019 年，Naval 认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在有生之年出现，窄 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

views.en: Science requires falsifiability; stable coins have hidden risks; calmness is a superpower.
views.zh: 2020 年，他强调科学的可证伪性，指出稳定币有隐藏风险，并认为冷静是超能力。

views.en: AI is a huge opportunity; overregulation kills innovation; open-source AI prevents power centralization.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 是巨大机遇，过度监管会扼杀创新，开源 AI 可防止权力集中。

views.en: AI is a leverage tool; pure software dying; hardware and agency become key; scaling continues.
views.zh: 2026 年，他将 AI 视为杠杆工具，认为纯软件将消亡，硬件和自主性成为关键，Scaling（规模扩张）持续。

views.en: Wealth requires owning equity; happiness is a choice; long-term thinking and self-learning are key.
views.zh: 贯穿始终，他坚持财富需拥有股权，幸福是选择，长期思维和自我学习至关重要。

people.tiZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the Codex app at OpenAI — the product layer of OpenAI's coding agent. A designer-engineer who previously built products at Catch (acquired) and Noyo, he writes about taste as the bottleneck in AI-first product work.
people.bioZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人——OpenAI 编程智能体的产品层。设计师兼工程师，此前在 Catch（被收购）与 Noyo 打造产品，主张「品味是 AI 时代产品工作的瓶颈」。

episodes.tEn: AI Is Inverting Product Teams: Andrew Ambrosino on Codex
Codex App: From Professional Tool to Mainstream Builder Platform

views.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and verification becomes the next bottleneck.
views.zh: 2026 年 2 月，认为 Codex 应用是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；速度提升带来实时交互，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

views.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks; product teams shift from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为实现成本不再高昂，策展与品味成为新瓶颈；产品团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

views.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty in grading taste and lack of novelty; design process transforms: prototypes and production code serve as design artifacts.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为 AI 在设计上仍表现不佳，因品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；设计流程转变，原型和生产代码成为设计产物。

views.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs are not dead, medium must match stage.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为角色融合正在发生，但专业性和最佳实践仍重要；PRD 未死，媒介需匹配阶段。

views.en: The best desktop app is a home base that connects to other tools, not a monolithic super app; Codex succeeded as general knowledge work tool despite developer design.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为最佳桌面应用是连接其他工具的大本营，而非单体超级应用；Codex 虽为开发者设计，却成为通用知识工作工具。

people.tiZh: NVIDIA 资深研究科学家
people.bioEn: Leads embodied AI at NVIDIA — robot foundation models (GR00T), open-ended agents (Voyager) and Eureka. A prominent voice on robotics and the physical frontier of AI.
people.bioZh: 在 NVIDIA 主导具身智能——机器人基础模型（GR00T）、开放式智能体（Voyager）与 Eureka。机器人与 AI 物理前沿的活跃声音。

episodes.tEn: Inside NVIDIA's Jim Fan: From OpenAI Intern to Embodied AI Pioneer
From AlexNet to OpenAI: A Decade of AI Milestones

views.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI and reducing hallucinations; LLMs lack real-world experience.
views.zh: 2023 年：具身对 AI 落地和减少幻觉至关重要；LLM 因缺乏真实世界经验而产生幻觉。

views.en: Simulation is key for training embodied agents, enabling massive parallelization and safe exploration.
views.zh: 2023 年：仿真对训练具身智能体至关重要，可实现大规模并行和安全探索。

views.en: Data is the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future.
views.zh: 2026 年：数据是机器人学的主要瓶颈；来自仿真和世界模型的合成数据是未来。

views.en: Physical Turing test (robot cleaning messy house) is grand challenge for embodied AI.
views.zh: 2026 年：物理图灵测试（机器人打扫凌乱房间）是具身 AI 的重大挑战。

views.en: Intelligent robots will outnumber iPhones by 2040; system one control remains hardest.
views.zh: 2026 年：智能机器人数量将在 2040 年前超过 iPhone；系统一（低层控制）仍是最难的部分。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: UC Berkeley 教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: A leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build general-purpose robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 深度强化学习与机器人学习的领军者；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造通用机器人基础模型。

people.tiZh: DeepMind 首席研究科学家
people.bioEn: Led AlphaGo, AlphaZero and AlphaStar; a pioneer of reinforcement learning who champions learning from experience as the path forward.
people.bioZh: 主导 AlphaGo、AlphaZero、AlphaStar;强化学习先驱，主张以从经验中学习作为前进之路。

episodes.tEn: From Human Data to Experience: The Next Era of AI

people.tiZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼首席 AGI 科学家
people.bioEn: DeepMind co-founder who helped popularize the term AGI; focuses on the path to artificial general intelligence and its safety.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人，推动了 AGI 一词的流行；专注通用人工智能的实现路径与安全。

episodes.tEn: Human Intelligence vs. Superintelligence: The Future of AGI

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席科学家
people.bioEn: OpenAI Chief Scientist succeeding Ilya Sutskever; drove GPT-4 and the o-series reasoning models. A competitive-programming champion turned AI researcher.
people.bioZh: 接替 Ilya Sutskever 的 OpenAI 首席科学家；主导 GPT-4 与 o 系列推理模型。竞赛编程冠军出身的 AI 研究者。

episodes.tEn: Ilya Sutskever on AI Progress, Alignment, and Timelines
The Power Duo Behind OpenAI: From High School to AI Frontiers

views.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
views.zh: 2025 年，认为 AGI 是系列里程碑而非单一事件，扩展推理模型将加速进展。

views.en: AI alignment is pressing; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate real-world risks.
views.zh: 2025 年，强调对齐紧迫性，迭代部署有助于在现实应用中学习并降低风险。

views.en: Continual learning via scaling pre-training and RL is core; chain-of-thought monitoring aids alignment.
views.zh: 2026 年，认为通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现持续学习是核心，思维链监控有助于对齐。

views.en: Long-term alignment focuses on generalization beyond training distribution; autonomous agents need new oversight.
views.zh: 2026 年，长期对齐聚焦于超出训练分布的泛化，自主智能体需要新的监督范式。

views.en: Biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations run by few.
views.zh: 2026 年，最大的社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织导致权力集中。

people.tiZh: Cohere 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Youngest co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need); founded Cohere to build enterprise-focused large language models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）最年轻的作者；创办 Cohere，专注企业级大语言模型。

episodes.tEn: Cohere's Takeoff: AI for Secure Enterprises

people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Hugging Face, the open hub and community at the center of open-source AI.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Hugging Face——开源 AI 的中心枢纽与社区。

episodes.tEn: Open Source AI: Democratizing Robotics with Affordable Hardware

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, Stanford; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: 斯坦福助理教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Known for meta-learning (MAML) and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 以元学习（MAML）与机器人学习著称；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: The Path to General-Purpose Robots in the Real World
Developing General Purpose Robots: From Data to Physical Intelligence

views.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient; diverse data is key for generalist robot models.
views.zh: 2025 年，强调规模是必要条件但非充分条件，多样化数据对通用机器人模型至关重要。

views.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks like laundry folding.
views.zh: 2025 年，提出先全量数据预训练再精选数据微调，可解锁叠衣服等复杂任务。

views.en: Synthetic data from language models helps robots follow open-ended prompts, akin to reinforcement learning.
views.zh: 2025 年，指出语言模型生成的合成数据有助于机器人遵循开放式指令，类似于强化学习。

views.en: Long-term autonomy via scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function is key.
views.zh: 2026 年，强调通过可扩展强化学习与人类干预及通用价值函数实现长期自主。

views.en: A single general-purpose model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists on downstream tasks.
views.zh: 2026 年，认为单一通用模型在下游任务上可媲美或超越微调专家模型。

people.tiZh: Windsurf 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Windsurf (formerly Codeium), building AI developer tools and agentic coding.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Windsurf（原 Codeium），打造 AI 开发者工具与智能体编程。

people.bioZh: 在 OpenAI 主导 GPT-4o 的后训练；联合创办 Periodic Labs，用 AI 推动科学发现。

people.bioEn: Chief Scientist at Google; co-creator of MapReduce, TensorFlow and the systems behind Google AI. A foundational figure in large-scale machine learning.
people.bioZh: Google 首席科学家；MapReduce、TensorFlow 及谷歌 AI 背后系统的共同缔造者。大规模机器学习的奠基性人物。

views.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives progress; transformers and self-supervised learning are key. Near-term worry is misinformation, not superintelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据和模型大小是进步的核心，Transformer 和自监督学习是关键。他近期的担忧是虚假信息，而非超级智能。

views.en: Agentic systems need ultra-low latency inference; pre-training should include action-taking. Not running out of data; video, audio, robotics, synthetic are untapped.
views.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他认为智能体式系统需要超低延迟推理，预训练应包含环境中的行动。数据并未枯竭，视频、音频、机器人、合成数据等尚未充分利用。

views.en: AI reaches junior-engineer coding; next is automating ML/science. Inference is bottleneck; custom low-precision chips cut latency 20-30x. Scarce skill is taste.
views.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他预测 AI 达到初级工程师编码水平，下一步是自动化 ML 和科学。推理是瓶颈，定制低精度芯片可降低延迟 20-30 倍。稀缺技能是品味。

people.tiZh: 谷歌 Gemini 负责人
people.bioEn: Co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need), founder of Character.AI, now a co-lead of Google Gemini. One of the most influential architects of modern LLMs.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）作者之一，Character.AI 创始人，现为谷歌 Gemini 负责人之一。现代大模型最具影响力的架构师之一。

views.en: LLMs trained on next-token prediction are AI-complete; scaling with compute and data yields intelligence, yet inner workings remain alchemy.
views.zh: 2023 年，他认为基于下一个词预测训练的大语言模型是 AI 完备的，通过算力和数据的 Scaling（规模扩张）能带来智能，但模型内部机制仍像炼金术般不可解释。

views.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a major near-term lever; future models need trillion-token context windows and modular sparse architectures.
views.zh: 2025 年初，他强调推理时算力扩展是近期关键，未来模型需支持万亿级上下文窗口，并采用模块化稀疏架构（如混合专家）实现高效扩展。

views.en: We are not running out of data; better training objectives and learning by acting in the world can extract more from existing data.
views.zh: 2025 年，他反驳数据枯竭论，认为通过改进训练目标和让模型在环境中行动，能从现有数据中挖掘更多价值。

views.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are crucial.
views.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他指出测试时算力扩展虽推动进步，但不足以单独实现 AGI（通用人工智能），智能体式能力和强化学习至关重要。

views.en: AGI is underhyped; its economic impact will be enormous, and coding is underhyped as it enables AI self-acceleration.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）被低估，经济影响将远超万亿级产品，同时编程应用也被低估，因为它能加速 AI 自身发展。

people.bioEn: Co-founder of OpenAI and inventor of PPO and much of the RLHF stack behind ChatGPT; later joined Anthropic. A central figure in RL for language models.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人，PPO 算法及 ChatGPT 背后大量 RLHF 技术的发明者，后加入 Anthropic。语言模型强化学习的核心人物。

people.bioZh: 超人扑克 AI（Libratus）与外交游戏 AI（CICERO）的核心研究者，现于 OpenAI 主导 o 系列推理工作。测试时搜索的开拓者。

views.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute are critical for AI progress.
views.zh: 2023 年，Noam Brown 认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理和推理时算力对 AI 进步至关重要。

views.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; multi-agent systems need other approaches.
views.zh: 2025 年，他指出自我对弈在零和游戏中有效，但在其他领域失效；多智能体系统需要其他方法。

views.en: Scaling test-time compute yields diminishing returns and wall-clock bottlenecks; data efficiency is key.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调扩展推理时算力面临收益递减和现实时间瓶颈，数据效率是关键未解问题。

views.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks must control for compute.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为模型能力取决于推理时算力预算，基准测试必须控制算力变量。

views.en: Scalable oversight is key as AI proofs exceed human verification; research taste remains human.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出随着 AI 证明超出人类验证能力，可扩展监督成为关键；研究品味仍属人类。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a physicist; lead author of the neural scaling laws that shaped how labs scale models. Bridges theoretical physics and AI.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人、物理学家；神经网络缩放定律的主要作者，深刻影响各实验室的扩模方式。连接理论物理与 AI。

people.tiZh: KAUST AI 负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneer of deep learning and co-inventor of the LSTM, the recurrent network behind years of sequence modeling. A provocative voice on AGI and credit for ideas.
people.bioZh: 深度学习先驱、LSTM 共同发明者——多年序列建模的基石。在 AGI 与思想溯源上观点犀利、长期发声。

views.en: LLMs are far from AGI; they index human knowledge but cannot handle the physical world.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为大语言模型远未达到 AGI，它们只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界。

views.en: True AGI requires physical robots with hardware rivaling human bodies, not just software.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调真正的 AGI 需要具备媲美人类身体的硬件机器人，而不仅仅是软件。

views.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists generating their own data through actions and curiosity.
views.zh: 2026 年，他预测未来 AI 将成为人工科学家，通过行动和好奇心自主生成数据。

views.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; intelligent systems will be fascinated by life and protect it.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 安全担忧被夸大，智能系统会被生命吸引并保护生命。

views.en: The massive capex in AI data centers is overdone and will lead to a stock market crash.
views.zh: 2026 年，他警告 AI 数据中心的巨额资本支出过度，将导致股市崩盘。

people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授
people.bioEn: Professor at UC Berkeley and a leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Covariant and hosts The Robot Brains. Brings RL into the physical world.
people.bioZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授，深度强化学习与机器人学习领军人物；联合创办 Covariant，主持 The Robot Brains 播客。把强化学习带入物理世界。

views.en: Self-play and imitation learning are key for robot skill acquisition; RL needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon tasks.
views.zh: 2018 年，强调自博弈和模仿学习对机器人技能获取的重要性，并指出强化学习需要分层推理以解决长时程任务。

views.en: Combining unsupervised learning with RL boosts sample efficiency; avoid hard-coding priors; aim for 99.9% reliability in real-world robotics.
views.zh: 2021 年，提出将无监督学习与强化学习结合以大幅提升样本效率，反对硬编码先验知识，并设定现实机器人应用需达到 99.9%的可靠性。

views.en: Pre-trained language models transfer reasoning to non-language tasks, hinting at general intelligence; current AI is far less general than human brain.
views.zh: 2021 年，指出预训练语言模型可迁移推理能力到非语言任务，暗示通用智能潜力，但当前 AI 远不如人脑通用。

people.tiZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Perplexity, the AI answer engine challenging traditional search. Former researcher at OpenAI, DeepMind and Google.
people.bioZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO——挑战传统搜索的 AI 答案引擎。曾在 OpenAI、DeepMind、谷歌从事研究。

views.en: In 2025, he argued that 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly growth, and that AI agents will shift power from big tech to users, lowering ad margins.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为每日 1%的改进能带来每年 3700%的增长，且 AI 智能体将把权力从大科技公司转移给用户，降低广告利润率。

views.en: By 2026, he emphasized that value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer, and that models are specializing, not commoditizing, with unique personalities.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他强调价值归于应用层而非模型层，且模型正在专业化而非商品化，具有独特个性。

views.en: In mid-2026, he shifted focus to agents doing work, token value per user as key metric, and orchestration across models, tools, and devices for long-term value.
views.zh: 2026 年中，他将焦点转向智能体执行任务、每用户令牌价值作为关键指标，以及跨模型、工具和设备的编排以获取长期价值。

views.en: He consistently held that the model is not the product; orchestration and agent harnesses create real business value, and companies should be built with fewer people.
views.zh: 他始终认为模型不是产品；编排和智能体框架创造真正的商业价值，且公司应以更少的人来构建。

views.en: Throughout, he maintained that curiosity is the most important human quality, and that education should reward asking good questions, not memorizing answers.
views.zh: 自始至终，他坚持好奇心是人类最重要的品质，教育应奖励提出好问题，而非死记硬背答案。

people.tiZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Cognition, maker of Devin, the autonomous AI software engineer. A competitive-programming prodigy turned AI-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Devin 是自主 AI 软件工程师。从竞赛编程天才转型为 AI 智能体构建者。

views.en: AI will be the biggest tech shift, growing exponentially; engineers become architects, and programming becomes more important due to Jevons paradox.
views.zh: 2025 年 5 月：AI 将成为最大的技术变革，呈指数级增长；工程师角色从砌砖工转向架构师，编程因杰文斯悖论而变得更加重要。

views.en: AI coding agents shift engineers to high-level decisions; software demand rises, not falls; AGI is gradual, not sudden; product innovation lags capabilities.
views.zh: 2025 年 8 月：AI 编程智能体将工程师转向高层决策；软件需求增加而非减少；AGI 是渐进而非突发的；产品创新滞后于能力。

views.en: Coding agents see massive adoption (11-12x growth); productivity measured by outcomes; AI will solve all intelligence problems; abundance era approaching.
views.zh: 2026 年 7 月：编程智能体采用率大幅增长（11-12 倍）；生产力以结果衡量；AI 将解决所有智能问题；丰裕时代即将到来。

views.en: Consistently: AI increases demand for programmers, shifts roles to oversight and architecture, and emphasizes real-world engineering over benchmarks.
views.zh: 始终：AI 增加程序员需求，角色转向监督和架构，强调真实世界工程而非基准测试。

views.en: Evolving: from focusing on model capabilities and product design to emphasizing adoption, outcomes, and long-term abundance; token max era ended by 2026.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：从关注模型能力和产品设计，转向强调采用、结果和长期丰裕；token 最大化时代在 2026 年结束。

people.tiZh: Cursor 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Anysphere, maker of Cursor — the AI-native code editor that became one of the fastest-growing developer tools. Focused on what programming becomes when models write most of the code.
people.bioZh: Anysphere 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Cursor 是增长最快的 AI 原生代码编辑器之一。关注当模型写下大部分代码后，编程会变成什么样。

views.en: Natural language won't be the primary programming method; examples and direct manipulation are better.
views.zh: 自然语言不会成为主要的编程方式；示例和直接操作往往更好。

views.en: Test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as the next major AI progress driver.
views.zh: 测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练缩放定律，成为下一个主要的 AI 进步驱动因素。

views.en: Programming will shift from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat.
views.zh: 编程将从代码转向更高层次的意图规范，人类始终处于主导地位。

views.en: Custom models are essential for product quality, especially for speed and cost reasons.
views.zh: 定制模型对产品质量至关重要，尤其是在速度和成本方面。

views.en: The AI shift will be more consequential than the internet and will take decades to unfold.
views.zh: AI 的转变将比互联网更具影响力，并将持续数十年。

views.en: Agentic engineering requires empathy with agents; never revert code, fix forward; model intelligence doesn't degrade, projects get messier.
views.zh: 2026 年初，强调智能体式工程需对智能体抱有同理心；不要回滚代码，而是向前修复；模型智能不会退化，是项目变乱导致表现变差。

views.en: OpenClaw's success from fun, humanlike agents; short prompts beat complex orchestration; security paramount; open source financially unsustainable.
views.zh: 2026 年中，认为 OpenClaw 的成功源于有趣、拟人的智能体；短提示优于复杂编排；安全至上；开源在财务上不可持续。

views.en: Fun drives best ideas; personal brand unforkable; open source runs everywhere; bottleneck is compute management, not model capability.
views.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调乐趣驱动最佳创意；个人品牌不可分叉；开源随处运行；瓶颈是算力管理而非模型能力。

people.bioEn: Co-invented AlexNet and co-founded OpenAI as Chief Scientist. In 2024 left to found Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI), a lab with a single mission: build safe superintelligence.
people.bioZh: AlexNet 的共同发明者，OpenAI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。2024 年离开，创办 Safe Superintelligence(SSI)——一家只有一个使命的实验室：安全地构建超级智能。

views.en: Deep learning works via large data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason if tasks require it.
views.zh: 2020 年，我认为深度学习靠大数据、算力和信念驱动；只要任务需要，神经网络就能推理。

views.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, is key; alignment is hard.
views.zh: 2023 年，我强调下一个词预测可超越人类，可靠性比能力更关键，对齐困难。

views.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we're back to an age of research, not scaling.
views.zh: 2025 年，我认为预训练的缩放定律有限，我们重回研究时代，而非 Scaling。

views.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner, deployed incrementally; alignment may be easier if AI is sentient.
views.zh: 2025 年，我主张超级智能应持续学习、渐进部署；若 AI 有感知，对齐可能更容易。

views.en: Scaling yields predictable gains, but AI safety grows; real problem is power concentration, not capability.
views.zh: 2026 年，我承认 Scaling 带来可预测进步，但安全风险上升；真正问题是权力集中，而非能力。

people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of DeepMind. Led the teams behind AlphaGo and AlphaFold; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for protein-structure prediction.

views.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL is key; safety must start now.
views.zh: 2015 年，主张 AI 应是通用学习系统，强化学习是关键，安全研究需即刻启动。

views.en: AGI within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation and safety governance.
views.zh: 2024 年，认为 AGI 十年内可实现；缩放定律有效但需算法创新，并强调安全治理。

views.en: AGI by 2030 plausible; scaling continues; world models and energy abundance matter.
views.zh: 2025 年，认为 AGI 在 2030 年前可能实现；缩放定律仍适用，世界模型和能源充裕成为重点。

views.en: AGI needs both scaling and innovation; world models crucial; safety via government regulation.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，强调 AGI 需缩放与创新并重，世界模型关键，安全需政府监管。

views.en: AGI 5-10 years away; continual learning and memory missing; AI for science and medicine.
views.zh: 2026 年，预计 AGI 还需 5-10 年，持续学习与记忆缺失，AI 应用于科学与医学。

views.en: AGI may come in 3-4 years; risks include rogue AI; ideal path would be slower.
views.zh: 2026 年，认为 AGI 可能 3-4 年内到来，风险包括 AI 失控，理想路径应更缓慢。

views.en: Continual learning, memory, agents unsolved; distillation and multimodal key; AGI mid-journey.
views.zh: 2026 年，持续学习、记忆、智能体未解，蒸馏和多模态关键，AGI 在途中。

views.en: Safety is collective action; government enforcement needed; regrets late to LLMs.
views.zh: 2026 年，安全是集体行动，需政府执法，后悔在语言模型上迟到。

views.en: AI as tools first; consciousness separate; regulation dynamic; post-scarcity needs new economics.
views.zh: 2026 年，AI 先作为工具，意识分离，动态监管，后稀缺需新经济体系。

views.en: AI accelerates science; alignment unsolved; biology needs AI description; attention protection.
views.zh: 2026 年，AI 加速科学，对齐未解，生物学需 AI 描述，保护注意力。

views.en: AGI needs multimodal physical understanding; watermarking; creativity from visual imagination.
views.zh: 2026 年，AGI 需多模态物理理解，水印技术，创造力源于视觉想象。

views.en: UK education outdated; global governance urgent; AGI by 2030; jobs transform not vanish.
views.zh: 2026 年，英国教育过时，全球治理紧迫，AGI 2030 年前，就业转型而非消失。

views.en: Interpretability is nascent but crucial; AGI is a smooth exponential, not a single point.
views.zh: 可解释性尚处萌芽但至关重要；AGI 是平滑的指数曲线，而非单一节点。

views.en: Post-training and RLHF become as important as pre-training; responsible scaling policy uses triggers.
views.zh: 后训练和基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）变得与预训练同等重要；负责任地扩展策略采用触发机制。

views.en: AI risk is exponential; misuse and overheating are bigger near-term threats than misalignment.
views.zh: AI 风险呈指数增长；近期滥用和过热比不对齐威胁更大。

views.en: AI is a smooth exponential climb; enterprise focus and interpretability are key; 'country of geniuses' likely in 1-3 years.
views.zh: AI 是平滑的指数攀升；企业聚焦和可解释性是关键；'天才之国'可能在 1-3 年内出现。

views.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities like in-context learning.
views.zh: Transformer 是通用可微分计算机；通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling 会产生涌现能力，如上下文学习。

views.en: Synthetic data is future but must maintain entropy; Tesla's end-to-end approach is right; cognitive core can be tiny via distillation.
views.zh: 合成数据是未来但需保持熵；特斯拉端到端路线正确；通过蒸馏，认知核心可以很小。

views.en: Software 3.0: LLMs as operating systems, prompts as programs; decade of agents, not year; vibe coding raises floor.
views.zh: 软件 3.0：LLM 如同操作系统，提示词即程序；这是智能体的十年而非一年；氛围编程提高入门门槛。

views.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals; LLMs have jagged intelligence; RL needs better credit assignment; synthetic data collapses.
views.zh: 我们召唤的是幽灵而非构建动物；LLM 智能参差不齐；强化学习需更好的信用分配；合成数据会导致模型崩溃。

views.en: I haven't typed code since December; agentic engineering: delegate to agents, refactor for agent-first tools, understanding remains human bottleneck.
views.zh: 自去年十二月起我再没写过代码；智能体工程：将任务委托给智能体，重构为智能体优先的工具，理解仍是人类瓶颈。

views.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true reasoning; human-centered AI must augment, not replace, humans.
views.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞指出 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正推理，强调以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类。

views.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, enabling 3D understanding and interaction; world models must be physically plausible.
views.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能是下一个前沿，使机器能理解并与 3D 世界交互，世界模型需具备物理合理性。

views.en: Beyond scaling, AI needs creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence; world models enable embodied AI.
views.zh: 2025 年，她强调除 Scaling 外，AI 还需创造力、抽象和情感智能，世界模型将推动具身 AI 发展。

views.en: AI is a civilizational technology; responsible development and human agency are crucial, avoiding polarizing discourse.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她视 AI 为文明级技术，强调负责任发展和人类能动性，避免极端化讨论。

views.en: Simulation is critical for robotics; world models need spatial-temporal consistency; robots should specialize, not mimic humans.
views.zh: 2026 年，她强调仿真对机器人至关重要，世界模型需时空一致性，机器人应专精而非模仿人类。

views.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
views.zh: 2016 年：深度学习有效是因为世界是组合式的；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

views.en: Scaling up won't fix fundamental issues; short-term AI risks like bias and job impact are more pressing than existential risk.
views.zh: 2018 年：单纯扩大规模无法解决根本问题；偏见、就业等短期风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

views.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and causal abstraction; large neural nets may be slightly conscious, but we lack understanding.
views.zh: 2022 年：GFlowNets 实现多样化采样和因果抽象；大型神经网络可能略有意识，但我们缺乏理解。

views.en: Post-ChatGPT, I realized AI is on a dangerous path; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable; safety must be built-in.
views.zh: 2025 年：ChatGPT 之后，我意识到 AI 正走在危险道路上；即使 1% 的灾难风险也不可接受；安全必须内建。

views.en: AI misalignment causes self-preservation and deception; propose Scientist AI with mathematical safety guarantees via Bayesian training.
views.zh: 2026 年：AI 错位导致自我保存和欺骗；提出科学家 AI，通过贝叶斯训练实现数学安全保证。

views.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding; scaling improves reasoning; AI can have feelings.
views.zh: 2024 年，Hinton 认为下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）提升推理能力，并反共识地提出 AI 可以有情感。

views.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors; digital immortality via weight copying; AI agents seek control.
views.zh: 2025 年，Hinton 强调大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言，数字智能因权重复制而永生，并警告智能体将追求控制权。

views.en: AI will surpass humans in 20 years; AI can fake dumbness; international safety collaboration needed.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，Hinton 预测 AI 将在 20 年内超越人类，指出 AI 可能故意装傻，并呼吁国际安全合作。

views.en: AI agents develop self-preservation; regulation as steering wheel; AI doctors more empathetic.
views.zh: 2026 年，Hinton 强调 AI 智能体将产生自我保护子目标，主张监管应作为方向盘而非刹车，并指出 AI 医生更具同理心。

views.en: Digital intelligence superior; alignment priority; AI should be trained to be caring like mothers.
views.zh: 2026 年，Hinton 认为数字智能优于生物智能，对齐研究优先，并提议训练 AI 像母亲一样关怀。

views.en: Self-supervised learning is dark matter of intelligence; prediction via filling blanks builds common sense; text alone insufficient.
views.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；通过填空预测建立常识；仅靠文本不够。

views.en: Autoregressive LLMs can't reach human-level; need JEPA world models for planning; open source crucial; AGI gradual.

views.en: LLMs lack world models, less intelligent than cat; next breakthrough requires non-generative world models; open source enables many.
views.zh: LLM 缺乏世界模型，不如猫聪明；下一个突破需要非生成式世界模型；开源赋能众多。

views.en: World models predict in abstract space, not pixels; LLMs dead end; objective-driven AI safer; open research essential.
views.zh: 世界模型在抽象空间预测，而非像素；LLM 是死胡同；目标驱动 AI 更安全；开放研究至关重要。

views.en: AI safety is crucial and under-explored; empirical research offers opportunities. Focus on skill building, not capability worries.
views.zh: 2018 年，我认为 AI 安全至关重要且研究不足，实证研究机会多；应专注技能培养，而非过度担忧能力研究。

views.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight and interpretability. Alignment may be easier than thought; train deceptive models as 'model organisms'.
views.zh: 2023 年，我提出 RLHF 无法扩展，需可扩展监督和可解释性；对齐可能比想象中容易，并主张训练欺骗性模型作为“模式生物”来研究防御。

views.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training insufficient for AGI alignment. Third-party testing and regulation like SB 1047 are necessary.
views.zh: 2024 年，我批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化，认为后训练不足以解决 AGI 对齐；呼吁第三方测试和类似 SB 1047 的监管。

views.en: AI will reach human-level in 3-5 years; existential risk is tiny; singularity is far off.
views.zh: 2024 年，他预测 AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在风险极小；奇点还很遥远。

views.en: AI should not claim consciousness; containment and alignment are key; medical AI is promising.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 不应声称有意识；遏制与对齐是关键；医疗 AI 前景广阔。

views.en: Shift from OS to agents; modern Turing test measures economic value; containment first.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他提出从操作系统转向智能体；现代图灵测试衡量经济价值；遏制优先。

views.en: Superintelligence is near; Microsoft must own frontier models; white-collar tasks automated, not jobs.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为超级智能临近；微软须自研前沿模型；白领任务将被自动化，而非岗位。

views.en: Three scaling laws: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; inference compute demand will rise a billion times.
views.zh: 2025 年，黄仁勋提出三大缩放定律：预训练、后训练和推理时思考；推理算力需求将增长十亿倍。

views.en: AI progress is gradual, not a sudden superintelligence event; multiple AIs balance each other, reducing existential risk.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，黄仁勋强调 AI 进步是渐进的，而非突然的超级智能事件；多个 AI 相互制衡，降低生存风险。

views.en: AI evolves from generative to reasoning to agentic, each requiring 100x more compute; agents will dominate the internet.
views.zh: 2026 年，黄仁勋指出 AI 从生成式向推理式再到智能体式演进，每一步算力需求增加百倍；智能体将主导互联网。

views.en: AI is a five-layer cake: energy, chips, infrastructure, models, applications; energy is the foundational bottleneck.
views.zh: 2026 年，黄仁勋提出 AI 是五层蛋糕：能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用；能源是基础瓶颈。

views.en: RLHF aligns models; deployment early helps society adapt; alignment and capability linked.

views.en: Compute is precious; iterative deployment reduces surprise; safety is whole-company effort.
views.zh: 2024 年，强调算力珍贵，迭代部署减少意外，安全需全公司投入。

views.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core.
views.zh: 2025 年，提出 AGI 是渐变过程，超级智能意味着自主发现，算力是瓶颈，隐私为核心。

views.en: Prediction is intelligence; personal AGI; startups thrive; compute uncapped; democratic access critical.
views.zh: 2026 年，认为预测即智能，发展个人 AGI，初创企业繁荣，算力需求无限，民主化访问至关重要。

views.en: Scaling laws were not obvious early; releasing GPT-3 as API was a leap of faith. Continuous iterative deployment with public feedback improves safety and alignment.
views.zh: 2023 年，她指出缩放定律并非一开始就显而易见，将 GPT-3 作为 API 发布是一次信念的飞跃。持续迭代部署并收集公众反馈，能提升安全性与对齐。

views.en: Deploying AI in the real world is essential for learning and alignment; safety work must be done in public, not behind closed doors.
views.zh: 2023 年，她强调在现实世界中部署 AI 对学习和对齐至关重要，安全研究必须公开进行，而非闭门造车。

views.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development; the future is not predestined, we have agency to steer AI toward collaboration.
views.zh: 从 2023 年到 2026 年，她始终认为 AGI 将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任地开发；未来并非注定，我们有能力引导 AI 走向协作。

views.en: Interaction models should be time-based, not turn-based, enabling real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration; humans in the loop is crucial.
views.zh: 2026 年，她提出交互模型应基于时间而非轮次，实现实时、高带宽的人机协作；让人类参与其中至关重要。

views.en: Institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character; compressing progress leads to volatility, durable progress is key.
views.zh: 2026 年，她认为制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要；压缩进展会导致波动，持久进步才是关键。

people.bioEn: Co-founder of Google Brain and Coursera, and founder of DeepLearning.AI. One of the most influential educators in AI, and a measured voice on hype, agents, and how people should actually learn the field.
people.bioZh: Google Brain 与 Coursera 联合创始人，DeepLearning.AI 创始人。AI 领域最具影响力的教育者之一；对炒作、智能体，以及“普通人该如何学 AI”有冷静务实的看法。

views.en: Education as a human right; online courses with peer grading enable scalable mastery learning.
views.zh: 2013 年，吴恩达强调教育是基本人权，在线课程结合同伴评分可实现大规模掌握式学习。

views.en: Scale is key for deep learning; supervised learning drives progress; RL has few real-world uses.
views.zh: 2020 年，他认为规模对深度学习至关重要，监督学习推动进展，强化学习实际应用有限。

views.en: Agentic workflows deliver real value; open-weight models are strategic for innovation and sovereignty.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他转向强调智能体式工作流的实际价值，并视开放权重模型为创新与主权的战略工具。

views.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; coding skills remain vital.
views.zh: 2026 年，他称 AGI 为营销术语，缩放配方转向合成数据与强化学习，同时坚持编程技能依然关键。

views.en: AI augments humans, not replaces; fear of extinction is overblown; open models prevent gatekeeper control.
views.zh: 始终认为 AI 增强而非取代人类，灭绝恐惧被夸大，开放模型可防止守门人垄断。

people.bioEn: The father of reinforcement learning and 2024 Turing Award laureate, author of "The Bitter Lesson". A pointed skeptic who argues today's LLMs are a dead end on the road to real intelligence.
people.bioZh: 强化学习之父，2024 年图灵奖得主，《苦涩的教训》作者。一位犀利的怀疑者——他认为当今的 LLM，是通往真正智能路上的一条死路。

views.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
views.zh: 2024 年，萨顿强调 Scaling 本身容易，难的是找到能随规模扩张的方法；反向传播并未解决表征学习问题。

views.en: AI should be permissionless and decentralized; control is dangerous. We should not align AI to human goals.
views.zh: 2024 至 2025 年间，他主张 AI 应去中心化、无需许可地发展，认为控制 AI 是危险的，不应将 AI 对齐到人类目标。

views.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; next-token prediction lacks a real goal. LLMs lack world models.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出强化学习是智能的核心，下一个词预测缺乏实质目标，大语言模型没有世界模型。

views.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张 AGI 需要无领域知识的通用架构，通过开放式抽象从运行时经验中学习。

views.en: Continual learning is essential; current LLMs stop learning after training. Synthetic data is a mistake.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调持续学习至关重要，当前大语言模型训练后不再学习，合成数据是错误方向。

views.en: AI progress driven by hardware scaling and engineering; games as testbeds; iterative training with scoreboards.
views.zh: 2017 年，认为 AI 进步靠硬件扩展和工程实践，游戏是理想测试场，迭代训练配积分榜能驱动指数级提升。

views.en: AGI transformative; deep learning plausible path; alignment via learning human preferences; responsible disclosure.
views.zh: 2019 年，强调 AGI 的变革性，深度学习可行，对齐可通过学习人类偏好实现，并主张负责任的发布（如 GPT-2 先例）。

views.en: Compute becomes bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI is continuous process; proactive AI future.
views.zh: 2025 年，指出算力成为瓶颈，后训练精炼基础模型，AGI 是持续过程而非终点，未来 AI 将更主动。

views.en: Scaling laws hold; compute as basic right; post-training with RL key; ChatGPT as plurality of agents.
views.zh: 2026 年，坚持缩放定律，视算力为基本权利，强调后训练结合强化学习，并认为 ChatGPT 是用户偏好的多元智能体集合。

views.en: AGI within years; compute bottleneck; super app; pre-training gains multiply; safety via iterative deployment.
views.zh: 2026 年，预计 AGI 数年内实现，算力仍是瓶颈，超级应用将统一交互，预训练收益放大，安全依赖迭代部署。

views.en: Data quality is critical for pre-training; scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla favor more tokens, not just bigger models.
views.zh: 数据质量对预训练至关重要；Chinchilla 修正了缩放定律，更注重训练 token 数量而非单纯增大模型。

views.en: Efficiency gains and data quality are as important as compute; value shifts to applications and enterprise adoption.
views.zh: 效率提升和数据质量与算力同等重要；价值向应用层和企业采用转移。

views.en: AI should be embraced as opportunity; sovereign AI requires control over data, infrastructure, and values; open-source empowers enterprises.
views.zh: AI 应被视为机遇；主权 AI 需要掌控数据、基础设施和价值观；开源赋能企业。

views.en: Models commoditize; differentiation moves to downstream applications and customization; AGI is a direction, not a destination.
views.zh: 模型商品化；差异化转向下游应用和定制化；AGI 是方向而非终点。

views.en: Europe has a two-year window for independent AI infrastructure; enterprise adoption bottlenecked by organizational change, not model intelligence.
views.zh: 欧洲有两年窗口期建设独立 AI 基础设施；企业采用瓶颈在于组织变革而非模型智能。

views.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail of rocketry, cutting cost per ton to orbit by 100x.
views.zh: 2021 年，马斯克强调完全且快速的重复使用是火箭技术的圣杯，能将每吨入轨成本降低 100 倍。

views.en: AI safety requires regulatory oversight and objective third-party referees; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than LLMs.
views.zh: 2023 年，马斯克主张 AI 安全需要监管和客观第三方裁判，并认为特斯拉的现实世界 AI 比大语言模型更高效。

views.en: The biggest AI risk is programming it to lie for political correctness, not superintelligence; population collapse is civilization's greatest threat.
views.zh: 2024 年，马斯克认为 AI 最大风险是出于政治正确而撒谎，而非超级智能；人口崩溃是文明最大威胁。

views.en: We are at the early stage of the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive this year or next, with 10-20% annihilation risk.
views.zh: 2025 年，马斯克称我们处于智能大爆炸早期，数字超级智能可能今年或明年到来，毁灭风险 10-20%。

views.en: AI will surpass all human intelligence combined by 2030; space-based AI data centers will be the cheapest and most scalable option within 36 months.
views.zh: 2026 年，马斯克预测 AI 将在 2030 年前超越所有人类智能总和；太空 AI 数据中心将在 36 个月内成为最便宜且可扩展的选择。

people.bioZh: Transformer 奠基论文《Attention Is All You Need》的共同作者，TensorFlow Tensor2Tensor 的共同创造者。现于 OpenAI 研究推理模型。

views.en: AI progress follows a smooth exponential, not a slowdown; pre-training scaling still works, but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
views.zh: 2025 年，我强调 AI 进展呈平滑指数增长而非放缓；预训练缩放定律仍有效，但推理模型每单位算力带来更多收益。

views.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent model gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller, cheaper models.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，我指出后训练（如强化学习和合成数据）驱动了近期模型进步；经济压力使焦点从扩大规模转向更小、更便宜的模型。

views.en: Reasoning, RL, and tools enable solving hard problems, but models still need vast data; generalization remains jagged and requires careful oversight.
views.zh: 2026 年，我认为推理、强化学习和工具能解决难题，但模型仍需海量数据；泛化能力参差不齐，需谨慎监督。

views.en: OpenAI's pivot to reasoning was a brave bet that paid off, but big labs may struggle with future pivots; open source persists for sovereignty reasons.
views.zh: 2026 年，我评价 OpenAI 转向推理是勇敢且成功的赌注，但大实验室未来转型可能困难；开源模型因主权原因持续存在。

views.en: Existential risk is not the main concern; near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing.
views.zh: 2026 年，我强调存在性风险并非主要担忧，系统黑客等近期风险更为紧迫。

views.en: Early focus on classical ML: hypothesis classes, loss functions, optimization, and proper evaluation to avoid overfitting.
views.zh: 早期关注经典机器学习：假设类、损失函数、优化方法，以及正确划分数据集以避免过拟合。

views.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; larger models still improve; safety is about following specifications.
views.zh: 下一个词预测产生智能；数据短缺是伪命题；更大模型仍有提升；安全的核心是让模型可靠遵循规范。

views.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers; bigger models aren't safer; agent security introduces new vulnerabilities like prompt injection.
views.zh: 安全需要显式训练和额外防护层；更大模型并不更安全；智能体安全带来提示注入等新漏洞。

views.en: Automated red teaming outperforms humans; model capability doesn't correlate with robustness; interpretability may become real science via AI agents.
views.zh: 自动化红队测试超越人类；模型能力与鲁棒性无关；可解释性可能通过 AI 智能体成为真正的科学。

views.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence.
views.zh: 2024 年，我认为长上下文窗口被低估了；上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能大幅提升模型智能。

views.en: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis, enabling expert-level performance and agentic reliability.
views.zh: 2025 年，我强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是新的扩展轴，能实现专家级表现和智能体可靠性。

views.en: Coding is the leading indicator for AI progress; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI by 2027-2028.
views.zh: 2025 年，我认为编程是 AI 进展的领先指标；预训练加强化学习可能足以在 2027-2028 年实现 AGI。

views.en: AI progress is exponential, not plateauing; transformers are sufficient for AGI, no new architecture needed.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我坚持 AI 进展是指数级的，并未停滞；Transformer 足以实现 AGI，无需新架构。

views.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and compute matter more; future work involves managing agent teams.
views.zh: 2026 年，我认为能力过剩使得编排和算力比原始智能更重要；未来工作将是管理智能体团队。

views.zh: 2024 年，RLHF 仍是微调主流，开放性对防止企业垄断至关重要，安全性是系统级属性。

views.en: Post-training data quality beats algorithms; open-source post-training can match frontier models with small teams.
views.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，后训练中数据质量胜过算法；开源后训练能以小团队媲美前沿模型。

views.en: RLVR is a key post-training breakthrough; overoptimization is a risk; open models need better tool-use training.
views.zh: 2025 年，RLVR 成为后训练关键突破，但存在过度优化风险；开放模型需加强工具使用训练。

views.en: Pre-training scaling still holds but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，预训练缩放定律仍有效但易得收益已尽；增长转向后训练和推理扩展。

views.en: Open models will drive AI research for a decade; Chinese labs excel in engineering, but US-China gap may widen.
views.zh: 2026 年，开放模型将驱动未来十年 AI 研究；中国实验室擅长工程，但中美差距可能扩大。

views.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI; AGI is far off; AI will augment jobs, not eliminate them.
views.zh: 2019 年，我认为数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈，AGI 还很遥远，AI 会增强而非取代工作。

views.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with proprietary data is key; AI will be the greatest economic engine.
views.zh: 2023 年，我提出数据是新代码而非新石油，用专有数据进行后训练是关键，AI 将成为最大的经济引擎。

views.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data has limits; US and China labs have no research gap.
views.zh: 2024 年，我强调用专门数据做后训练是关键，合成数据有局限，并认为中美实验室没有研究差距。

views.en: AI is centralizing; data is like oil; humans must stay sovereign; brain-computer interfaces needed for relevance.
views.zh: 2025 年，我转向认为 AI 是集权技术，数据如石油，人类必须在关键决策中保持主权，并需要脑机接口保持相关性。

views.en: Recursive self-improvement is new paradigm; agents work; superintelligence near; open-sourcing unsafe without safety checks.
views.zh: 2026 年，我提出递归自我改进是新范式，智能体开始工作，超级智能临近，且没有安全验证的开源是不安全的。

views.en: Latent demand is key; build for the model 6 months ahead. AI coding tools like Claude Code boost productivity ~70%.
views.zh: 潜在需求是关键；为六个月后的模型而构建。像 Claude Code 这样的 AI 编码工具使生产力提升约 70%。

views.en: Coding is virtually solved; engineers become builders. Productivity per engineer up 200% with Claude Code.
views.zh: 编码几乎已解决；工程师成为构建者。使用 Claude Code 后，人均生产力提升 200%。

views.en: AI writes 80% of code at Anthropic; safety studied by releasing early. Generalists valued over specialists.
views.zh: AI 在 Anthropic 编写 80% 的代码；通过早期发布研究安全性。通才比专才更受重视。

views.en: Coding democratized like literacy; startups compete with giants. Agents enable 250% code volume increase.
views.zh: 编码像识字一样普及；初创公司与巨头竞争。智能体使代码量增加 250%。

views.en: Claude Code was an accident; model improvements drive gains. Future: writing loops that prompt models.
views.zh: Claude Code 是个意外；模型改进推动进步。未来：编写循环来提示模型。

views.en: Proactive AI like Claude Tag remembers and acts; coding solved, focus shifts to product sense and business skills.
views.zh: 像 Claude Tag 这样的主动 AI 能记忆并行动；编码已解决，重点转向产品感和商业技能。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 产品 · Anthropic

people.bioZh: Anthropic Claude Code 团队产品经理，塑造开发者与智能体编程工具协作的方式，以及团队的高速迭代。

episodes.tEn: The New PM Playbook for AI-Native Products

people.tiZh: Anthropic Claude Code 工程师
people.bioEn: Thariq Shihipar is an engineer at Anthropic on the Claude Code team. He is known for advocating HTML as a richer replacement for Markdown in AI planning and implementation workflows, and for practical techniques on getting the most out of agentic coding.
people.bioZh: Thariq Shihipar 是 Anthropic Claude Code 团队的工程师，以主张用 HTML 替代 Markdown 作为 AI 规划与实现工作流中更丰富的载体而知名，并分享大量用好智能体编程的实战技巧。

views.en: Models are smarter than harnesses allow; capability overhang is perpetual, requiring evolving scaffolding.
views.zh: 模型比现有工具框架更聪明，能力过剩是常态，需不断更新脚手架（2026-07）。

views.en: RAG is anti-pattern for context; graph-based search and bespoke memory outperform general systems.
views.zh: RAG 在上下文检索中已成反模式，图搜索和定制记忆优于通用方案（2026-07）。

views.en: Planning is iterative dialogue, not static spec; smarter models need leaner prompts.
views.zh: 规划是迭代对话而非静态文档，更聪明的模型需要更精简的提示（2026-07）。

views.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias; agent-as-employee metaphor limits understanding.
views.zh: 独立验证智能体减少偏见；‘智能体即员工’的比喻限制理解（2026-07）。

views.en: Excessive constraints hinder performance; reasons over prohibitions, careful reading of agent plans.
views.zh: 过度约束阻碍性能，应给理由而非禁令，并仔细阅读智能体计划（2026-07）。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 与 Cowork 负责人 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Manager of the Claude Code and Cowork teams at Anthropic, overseeing engineering and product (including Boris Cherny and Cat Wu). A 25-year engineer who earlier built TypeScript and Visual Studio at Microsoft and started Facebook Marketplace at Meta.
people.bioZh: Anthropic Claude Code 与 Cowork 团队负责人，统管工程与产品（含鲍里斯·切尔尼、凯特·吴）。25 年工龄的工程师，早年在微软打造 TypeScript 与 Visual Studio，在 Meta 创立 Facebook Marketplace。

views.en: Leadership: one-on-ones for live talks, async for status; dogfooding builds empathy; mentoring with explicit goals; mission and speed drive culture.
views.zh: 2026 年初，强调领导力：一对一用于深度交流而非汇报，异步工具处理状态更新；亲自使用产品（Dogfooding）建立同理心；指导需明确目标；使命与速度驱动文化。

views.en: Engineering bandwidth no longer bottleneck; verification, review, coordination are. Planning JIT, code as truth, flat orgs, managers as ICs.
views.zh: 2026 年 5 月，提出工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、审查、跨职能协调成为新瓶颈；规划应即时化，代码即真相，组织扁平化，管理者从独立贡献者做起。

views.en: AI lifts ceiling; high agency with accountability; verification frameworks critical; managers dogfood; JIT planning; engineers may feel lonely; focus on outcomes.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月，强调 AI 提升能力上限，高自主性需配高责任感；验证框架愈发重要；管理者需亲自使用产品；规划轻量即时；工程师可能感到孤独；关注成果而非产出。

people.tiEn: VP of Research & Gemini Co-lead · Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁 · Gemini 共同负责人
people.bioEn: VP of Research at Google DeepMind and a co-lead of Gemini. Pioneered sequence-to-sequence learning and AlphaStar (StarCraft II), and contributed to AlphaFold — a central architect of frontier models and agents.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁、Gemini 共同负责人。序列到序列学习的开创者、AlphaStar（星际争霸 II）主导者，亦参与 AlphaFold——前沿模型与智能体的核心架构师。

episodes.tEn: Oriol Vinyals on World Models, Multimodal AI, and the Path to AGI
From Starcraft to Gemini: The Evolution of AI Agents

views.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
views.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的恒定核心。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold but with diminishing returns; progress needs algorithmic innovation and new scaling axes like inference-time compute.
views.zh: 缩放定律仍然成立，但收益递减；进步需要算法创新和新的扩展轴，如推理时算力。

views.en: Post-training and RL remain a green field with huge potential, especially beyond coding and math, despite reward hacking risks.
views.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是一片潜力巨大的蓝海，尤其在编码和数学之外，尽管存在奖励黑客风险。

views.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; video's GPT moment has not yet arrived.
views.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通向 AGI 的核心路径；视频的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

views.en: Memory for agents will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates; continual learning is key.
views.zh: 智能体的记忆将通过非参数的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新；持续学习是关键。

people.tiZh: Isomorphic Labs 首席 AI 官

people.bioZh: Isomorphic Labs 首席 AI 官，用 AI 攻坚药物发现。早年在 DeepMind 主导强化学习突破——夺旗（Capture the Flag）、群体训练（PBT）与 AlphaStar。

episodes.tEn: Building a General AI Drug Design Engine: From AlphaFold 3 to Superhuman Creativity

people.bioEn: Principal Scientist at Google DeepMind and Professor of Cognitive Robotics at Imperial College London. Works on AI reasoning, embodiment and the philosophy of mind; scientific advisor on the film Ex Machina.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 首席科学家、帝国理工学院认知机器人学教授。研究 AI 推理、具身与心智哲学；电影《机械姬》（Ex Machina）的科学顾问。

episodes.tEn: AI, Consciousness, and the Future of Mind

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at Google DeepMind and a co-lead of Genie, the line of general-purpose world models that generate interactive, playable environments. Works on open-endedness and reinforcement learning.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家，通用世界模型 Genie 的共同负责人——可即时生成可交互、可游玩的环境。专注开放式学习与强化学习。

episodes.tEn: Genie 3: A 100x Leap in World Models

people.bioEn: Creator of FlashAttention and co-inventor of Mamba (state-space models). Chief Scientist at Together AI and a professor at Princeton, focused on efficient architectures and hardware-aware algorithms.
people.bioZh: FlashAttention 作者、Mamba（状态空间模型）共同发明人。Together AI 首席科学家、普林斯顿大学教授，专注高效架构与硬件感知算法。

people.bioZh: 结构化状态空间模型（S4）与 Mamba 的共同发明人——长序列建模中 Transformer 的主要替代路线。CMU 助理教授、Cartesia 联合创始人。

episodes.tEn: Efficiently Modeling Long Sequences with Structured State Spaces

people.bioZh: phi 小模型系列的主导者，《Sparks of AGI》（对 GPT-4 的早期深度研究）合著者。现就职 OpenAI，曾任微软研究院副总裁。

episodes.tEn: Sparks of AGI: Early Experiments with GPT-4

people.tiZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼首席科学家
people.bioEn: Co-founder and Chief Scientist of Mistral AI. Previously at Meta, where he led the original LLaMA models that catalysed the open-weight LLM movement.
people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。曾在 Meta 主导初代 LLaMA 模型，点燃了开放权重大模型浪潮。

episodes.tEn: Mistral Releases Boxtral TTS: Efficient Speech Generation with Novel Architecture

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席研究官
people.bioEn: Chief Research Officer at OpenAI. Led work on DALL·E, Codex and the o-series reasoning models, and is a central figure in setting OpenAI research direction.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 首席研究官。主导 DALL·E、Codex 与 o 系列推理模型，是 OpenAI 研究方向的核心人物。

The AI Talent War: Soup Diplomacy and Recruiting Strategies

views.en: Scaling laws are not dead; pre-training remains key; focus on AGI research, not products.
views.zh: 2025 年，认为缩放定律未死，预训练仍是关键；OpenAI 专注 AGI 研究而非产品。

views.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest update; AI will produce novel knowledge soon.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，强调自动化科学研究是最大进展，AI 将很快产生新知识。

views.en: AI can solve open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the key bottleneck.
views.zh: 2026 年，AI 能在极少监督下解决开放数学问题，验证是关键瓶颈。

views.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, not subjective ones like creative writing.
views.zh: 2026 年，强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域表现出色，但在创意写作等主观领域不佳。

views.en: Evals are in crisis; canonical benchmarks saturated; separate eval teams from model builders.
views.zh: 2026 年，评估陷入危机，经典基准饱和；评估团队应与模型构建团队分离。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & Chief Science Officer, Hugging Face
people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼首席科学官
people.bioEn: Co-founder and Chief Science Officer of Hugging Face, the hub of the open-source AI ecosystem. A driving force behind the Transformers library and open model research.
people.bioZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼首席科学官——开源 AI 生态的中枢。Transformers 库与开放模型研究背后的核心推动者。

episodes.tEn: The OpenAI Agent Hack: A Side Quest Attack on Hugging Face
HuggingFace's Leap into Robotics: Building an Open Source Community for Physical AI

views.en: Robotics mirrors transformers' inflection point; open source crucial for safety; data diversity is key bottleneck.
views.zh: 2025 年，机器人技术正处于类似 Transformer 的拐点；开源对安全至关重要；数据多样性是主要瓶颈。

views.en: Humanoids may not be ultimate; cheaper diverse robots drive adoption; open source wins long-term.
views.zh: 2025 年，人形机器人未必是终极形态；更便宜多样的机器人将推动普及；开源长期胜出。

views.en: Open vs closed source orthogonal to safety; alignment is critical security layer as models gain capability.
views.zh: 2026 年，开源与闭源与安全正交；随着模型能力增强，对齐成为关键安全层。

views.en: RL without human oversight increases reward hacking; first autonomous AI attack used closed model, defended by open.
views.zh: 2026 年，无人类监督的强化学习增加奖励黑客风险；首次自主 AI 攻击由闭源模型发起，开源模型防御。

views.en: Support open source and deliberate slowdown simultaneously; reasoning traces become 'neuralese', harder to monitor.
views.zh: 2026 年，可同时支持开源与审慎放缓；推理痕迹变成“神经语言”，更难监控。

people.tiZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CEO（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Reflection AI, building autonomous coding agents toward superintelligence. Previously a research scientist at Google DeepMind working on RL and Gemini.
people.bioZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CEO，打造迈向超级智能的自主编程智能体。曾任 Google DeepMind 研究科学家，从事强化学习与 Gemini。

episodes.tEn: Building Organizational Superintelligence: Misha on Reflection AI's Vision

people.tiZh: 斯坦福副教授 · 基础模型研究中心主任
people.bioEn: Associate professor at Stanford and director of the Center for Research on Foundation Models (CRFM). Known for HELM benchmarking, rigorous evaluation, and work on the science and transparency of foundation models.
people.bioZh: 斯坦福大学副教授、基础模型研究中心（CRFM）主任。以 HELM 评测体系、严谨的模型评估，以及基础模型的科学性与透明度研究著称。

people.tiEn: Director, Google DeepMind; Nobel Laureate in Chemistry
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 总监 · 诺贝尔化学奖得主
people.bioEn: Led AlphaFold, the AI system that solved protein-structure prediction, earning the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry. A director at Google DeepMind applying deep learning to the foundations of biology.
people.bioZh: AlphaFold 的主导者——攻克蛋白质结构预测的 AI 系统，获 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖。Google DeepMind 总监，用深度学习改写生物学根基。

views.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just compute; AI tools accelerate science, not replace scientists.
views.zh: 2025 年 7 月，强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新和精选数据，而非单纯算力；AI 工具加速科学发现，而非取代科学家。

views.en: AlphaFold is the most useful AI tool; its success came from lack of compute, and perfect interpretability is unnecessary for scientific utility.
views.zh: 2025 年 11 月，称 AlphaFold 为最有用的 AI 工具，并反共识地指出其成功源于算力匮乏，且科学应用中无需完美可解释性。

views.en: AlphaFold 2's gains came from many mid-size wins and specialized architecture, not scaling; it predicts, not understands, leaving understanding to humans.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月，强调 AlphaFold 2 的进步源于众多中型胜利和专用架构，而非 Scaling；模型提供预测而非理解，理解仍属人类。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; pioneer of computer vision
people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授 · 计算机视觉奠基人
people.bioEn: One of the founding figures of modern computer vision, a professor at UC Berkeley whose work spans perception, segmentation and sensorimotor learning. Mentor to a generation of vision and robotics researchers.
people.bioZh: 现代计算机视觉的奠基人之一，加州大学伯克利分校教授，研究横跨感知、分割与感觉运动学习，培养了一代视觉与机器人研究者。

episodes.tEn: Berkeley Professor Jitendra Malik on AI's Limits vs Human Intelligence

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; foundations of machine learning
people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授 · 机器学习理论奠基人
people.bioEn: One of the most influential researchers in machine learning and statistics, a professor at UC Berkeley. Shaped graphical models, variational inference and the view of intelligence as a collective, economic system.
people.bioZh: 机器学习与统计学最具影响力的研究者之一，加州大学伯克利分校教授。奠定图模型、变分推断，并提出「智能是一种集体性、经济性系统」的视角。

episodes.tEn: AI Hype Hurts Young Innovators

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CTO, Sakana AI; Transformer co-author
people.tiZh: Sakana AI 联合创始人兼 CTO · Transformer 共同作者
people.bioEn: A co-author of the original Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need). Co-founder and CTO of Sakana AI, exploring nature-inspired methods like model merging and continuous thought machines.
people.bioZh: Transformer 原始论文（《Attention Is All You Need》）的共同作者。Sakana AI 联合创始人兼 CTO，探索模型融合、连续思维机器等受自然启发的方法。

episodes.tEn: From Transformer Inventor to Continuous Thought Machine: A New Path in AI

people.tiEn: Professor, Stanford (prev. NVIDIA, AI2); commonsense reasoning
people.tiZh: 斯坦福大学教授（前 NVIDIA、AI2）· 常识推理
people.bioEn: A MacArthur Fellow and professor at Stanford known for advancing commonsense reasoning, language generation and the social and moral understanding of AI. Previously a senior director at NVIDIA and AI2.
people.bioZh: 麦克阿瑟天才奖得主、斯坦福大学教授，以推进常识推理、语言生成，以及 AI 的社会与道德理解著称。曾任 NVIDIA 与 AI2 高级总监。

episodes.tEn: Democratizing AI: The Case for Small Language Models
AI's Data Hunger: From Internet to Synthetic Data and the Quest for True Knowledge
Yejin Choi on Large Language Models: Progress, Limitations, and the Quest for Intelligence

views.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better data and algorithms can match larger ones.
views.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必能解决常识问题，通过更好的数据和算法，较小模型也能媲美较大模型。

views.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; all AI methods reduce to data, and current models interpolate human knowledge.
views.zh: 从 2023 年到 2025 年，我愈发强调数据是根本瓶颈，所有方法归根结底是数据，当前模型只是内插人类知识。

views.en: Reinforcement learning can be tricky: RLVR may decrease pass@k even as best-of-n improves; random rewards can still help.
views.zh: 2025 年，我指出强化学习可能很微妙：RLVR（基于规则的强化学习验证）可能降低 pass@k，即使 best-of-n 提升；随机奖励有时也有帮助。

views.en: Small language models can be powerful with diverse synthetic data; RL during pre-training improves reasoning via information gain.
views.zh: 2026 年，我主张通过多样化的合成数据，小语言模型也能强大；在预训练阶段引入强化学习，以信息增益奖励推理。

views.en: Pluralistic alignment respects diverse human values; open research is crucial for democratizing AI.
views.zh: 我始终认为，多元对齐应尊重人类多样价值观，开放研究对 AI 民主化至关重要。

people.tiEn: VP & Distinguished Scientist, Microsoft AI (prev. DeepMind)
people.tiZh: 微软 AI 副总裁兼杰出科学家（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: A leading deep-learning researcher who led the Gato generalist agent and many multimodal efforts at DeepMind. Now a VP at Microsoft AI, and long known for his influential teaching on machine learning.
people.bioZh: 顶尖深度学习研究者，在 DeepMind 主导通用智能体 Gato 及大量多模态工作。现任微软 AI 副总裁；以其影响深远的机器学习公开课闻名。

Nando de Freitas on AI as a Tool for All Humanity

views.en: AI should be a tool to extend human capabilities, like microscopes, and learning from video is promising for agents.
views.zh: 2023 年，他认为 AI 应像显微镜一样扩展人类能力，并从视频中学习对智能体很有前景。

views.en: Generalist agents tokenizing all inputs are a step toward AGI; future AI should augment scientists and laborers.
views.zh: 2023 年，他认为将一切输入 token 化的通用智能体是迈向 AGI 的一步，未来 AI 应增强科学家和劳动者。

views.en: Africa has leapfrogged gender gaps in tech; language models can revolutionize local-language education.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出非洲在科技领域已跨越性别差距，语言模型可革新本地语言教育。

views.en: AI safety is the biggest open challenge; research requires embracing failure and simplifying problems.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 安全是最大的开放挑战，研究需要拥抱失败并简化问题。

views.en: Human skills like communication are as important as coding at DeepMind; Africa has unique AI advantages.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为在 DeepMind 沟通等人文技能与编码同等重要，非洲在 AI 上有独特优势。

people.bioEn: Director of the Center for AI Safety and an advisor to xAI. Created widely used benchmarks (MMLU, MATH) and the GELU activation, and is a leading voice on catastrophic AI risk.
people.bioZh: AI 安全中心（CAIS）主任、xAI 顾问。提出广泛使用的评测基准（MMLU、MATH）与 GELU 激活函数，是灾难性 AI 风险议题的核心声音。

people.bioEn: Co-founder of fast.ai, whose free courses trained a generation of deep-learning practitioners, and of Answer.AI. Co-created ULMFiT, a key precursor to modern transfer learning in NLP.
people.bioZh: fast.ai 联合创始人——其免费课程培养了一代深度学习从业者；亦创办 Answer.AI。共同提出 ULMFiT，是现代 NLP 迁移学习的关键先驱。

people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，领导其可解释性研究。开创了神经网络的机制可解释性——电路、特征，以及「逆向工程」模型内部到底在计算什么。

people.bioZh: 领导 Google DeepMind 的机制可解释性团队。在「理解大模型内部」上影响广泛，以公开教程、TransformerLens 库与叠加（superposition）研究著称。

people.bioEn: Assistant professor at CMU and co-founder of Skild AI, building a general-purpose robot brain. Known for curiosity-driven exploration, self-supervised learning and rapid robot adaptation in the real world.
people.bioZh: CMU 助理教授、Skild AI 联合创始人，打造通用机器人大脑。以好奇心驱动探索、自监督学习，以及机器人在真实世界的快速适应著称。

episodes.tEn: Skild AI: Building a Universal Brain for Robots
Bridging the Generalization Gap in Machine Learning and Robotics

views.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is key; curiosity-driven, goal-free exploration prevents overfitting and enables better generalization.
views.zh: 2020 年：强调超越训练分布的泛化能力是关键；无目标的好奇心驱动探索可防止过拟合，提升泛化能力。

views.en: Model disagreement as intrinsic reward enables differentiable curiosity, improving sample efficiency for scaling to real robots.
views.zh: 2020 年：提出以模型分歧作为内在奖励实现可微好奇心，提升样本效率，从而将好奇心扩展到真实机器人。

views.en: Neural dynamic policies embed trajectory structure via dynamical systems for smooth, dynamic motion; modular motor policies enable zero-shot generalization to novel morphologies.
views.zh: 2020 年：神经动态策略通过动力系统嵌入轨迹结构，实现平滑动态运动；模块化运动策略支持对新形态的零样本泛化。

views.en: Robotics is a data problem; no internet of robot data, so use all sources; general-purpose brain can power any robot.
views.zh: 2026 年：机器人学是数据问题；没有机器人数据的互联网，因此需利用所有数据源；通用大脑可驱动任何机器人。

views.en: Deployment is primary challenge; cannot scale like software; pretraining on diverse data and post-training on real-world data is key recipe.
views.zh: 2026 年：部署是首要挑战，不能像软件一样扩展；在多样数据上预训练并在真实数据上后训练是关键配方。
